reason: I already decided to go into the new market and I have no pipeline there, so a free target list and a pilot where the first 3 meetings cost nothing and I can't pay more than EUR 900 is low risk for me. I approve every first message, so I keep control over what goes out under our name.
objection: The cold emails go out to buyers in a market where nobody knows us yet. If they come across as spam, or someone complains about GDPR, our first impression there is ruined and I can't undo it. One logistics client with 45 meetings doesn't prove it works for a wholesaler like us.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 sample companies are generic or the local-language message reads like spam, I would walk away after step 1.
